scene: Three golden transit tokens spill from the cracked capsule into your hands.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along an outdoor transit terminal platform. Far left, a maglev dragon train waits with its doors open. Centre, the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in floral shirt and top knot holds three golden tokens, ukulele slung on his back. Up high hangs a cloud cable pod. Far right, a solar-sail junk is moored.
shown: a maglev dragon train waiting with open jaws at the far left platform
a rounded cloud cable pod swaying gently on a wire up high
a solar-sail junk moored at a sparkling canal dock on the far right
